meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 会充当主持人,把每个 git 工作树、分支或 PR 当作虚拟代理,拉进只读共享聊天室,分轮次比较改动、解决冲突,产出一份合并计划(目标分支、合并顺序、遗留决策),用大白话汇报,再把计划交给 /do 执行。
howto.when: 当你要求对多个 git 工作树、分支或 PR 做一次只读的 standup 来比较改动、制定合并计划时;或直接说'跑一个 standup'时触发。

say.text: 把最近 24 小时有改动的分支拉起来开个 standup,给个合并方案。
say.note: Claude 会按最近活动筛选工作树,召集所有代理开会。

say.text: 对比这几个 PR 的改动,协调出一条合并计划。
say.note: Claude 会拉取 PR 和本地分支,按轮次协调出计划。

say.text: 对 main 和 feature-x 做一次只读 standup,产出合并顺序。
say.note: Claude 会发起 standup,最终给出合并顺序。

howto.what_en: Claude facilitates a read-only standup: each worktree/branch/PR joins a shared chat as an agent; rounds compare changes/resolve conflicts; output is one consolidation plan (target, merge order, decisions) plus a plain-language summary, then /do performs merges.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to run a read-only standup across multiple git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce a consolidation plan, e.g. saying 'run a standup'.

say_en.text: Run a standup for branches changed in 24h and give a merge plan.
say_en.note: Claude filters worktrees by activity and starts the room.

say_en.text: Compare these PRs and coordinate a consolidation plan.
say_en.note: Claude fetches PRs and runs rounds to reconcile.

say_en.text: Do a read-only standup on main and feature-x and give the merge order.
say_en.note: Claude holds the standup and gives the merge order.
